svg.text: Nudge eight levers. Don’t slam one.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each pathway adds maybe 5–10%. Tap all eight and you out-build any single compound — with a fraction of the risk.

svg.text: The win isn’t a bigger dose; it’s eight channels parked in their windows, summing to one clean output. The amateur rails

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the testosterone fader and clips the master into the red. The professional rides all eight a little, and the board never distorts.
CONSOLE · EIGHT ANABOLIC CHANNELS → ONE MASTER OUTPUT
green = in window · amber = over-driven · red = master clip
